last_summary: Trajectory Note 7 — ELECTRO-CULTURE AND MAGNETO-CULTURE (trajectory lane, run 7; gear 1, free `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, no gear-2, no quota error). Wrote `navigator/trajectory/2026-10-07-electro-culture.md` (33 KB) and appended entry 7 to `navigator/trajectory/index.json` (now 7 themes: water, vortex/implosion, form-waves/radiesthesia, aether-as-information, biofield/biophotonics, longitudinal-waves, electro-culture). THE LINE: one name, three centuries, >=5 incompatible operational claims (1746->2026); the meaning drifted from a machine you plug in to a product you buy. 'Electro-culture' 1746 = kilovolt-class active apparatus aimed at plants (Maimbray/Nollet 1746/47; Laemstrom 1885 aerial ~40% avg BUT the source's OWN counter-example: cabbage/turnips/flax grew better WITHOUT electrification; Blackman 1924 ~50% at 60V DC; 1918-21 British electrified seed soak ~2,000 acres; 1964 USDA tree electrode +300%); by the 2020s it ALSO names 'passive electroculture' - copper-wrapped dowels with NO power source, sold in big-box stores - which the Yard's CLEANEST card refuted (Chier et al., PLOS ONE 20(8):e0329615 2025, NSF DEB 1941390; four species, n=10/arm, randomized, promoter-independent; a rod transmits ~2 mV into soil vs hundreds of volts of active tests). The Vault's own shelf records the drift: ~26 distinct ElectroCulture works (36 doc-title entries) from Christofleau/Parry USP 2308204/Levengood/Liu Binjiang/Truffaut/Couillaud 1942 to 2020s retail titles (Complete Electroculture Bible, Electroculture 101, Advanced Electroculture) - register drains from specification to how-to, the same shape as the French form-wave apparatus drift (synthesis/2026-09-15). Meanwhile the live science migrated into magneto-culture, which the archive's own quest card had flagged as 'the one part of electro-culture that is not wholly fringe'. LADDER (the archive's BEST-populated): two independent NULLS (copper dowel; constant <=14 mT field on wheat/mustard, Ivanov & Sokolova 2025) + one institutional mechanism POSITIVE (HVEF tomato, Shanxi Agricultural University 2026, +HVEF -> leaf Mg 1.58x control, raised chlorophyll/Rubisco, -HVEF = 'promotion first, inhibition later'; single lab, press-release deep). The three electro-side records are DIFFERENT experiments and must not be scored as a tally - honest composite: dose-, polarity- and delivery-dependent. MAGNETO side: the defining finding is the DISPERSION of effect size, not any number - ~25% (Belgrade 2026 cabbage field +24.8% head weight at 350 mT) vs ~78% (soybean lab vigour index) vs ~199% (safflower field, unread) vs 0% (Minnesota 1975: five crops, four locations, four reps, same-lot treated/untreated adjacent, 'no significant advantage', never out-replicated). What IS converging is not a magnitude but a SHAPE: dose-, frequency/window-, polarity- and delivery-dependent and non-monotonic (shorter often beats longer; 5-10 Hz repeatedly the active window - aniseed 2026 catalase ~4.5x at 10 Hz, sod down). HOME RUNG specified to protocol grade and NEVER run: Dossier 026 (2026-09-19, status protocol; results log '(none yet'), ~$20-40, first signal in 48 h; arms = N/S/sham magnet seed treatment (blind; germination % + 48-h shoot length) + Lakhovsky one-turn coil (4-6 wk); PASS = N-pole >=20% higher germination OR >=30% greater 48-h shoot length vs sham across two runs AND S-pole != N-pole; FAIL = all within +/-10%. Kitchen rig cannot resolve 5% but CAN resolve the source's asserted 2x/5x; a clean null is first-class output. GRAPH: d_agriculture/d_magnetism/d_electromagnetism all degree 0, NO electro-culture concept node; graph frozen 2026-09-06. CORPUS: no category named for electro-culture; mass sits in Regenerative Agriculture (259) and Electromagnetic Theory (15,390). QUESTION THAT WOULD MOVE IT: does the effect survive its own cheapest control - sham-treated seed, handled identically, field switched off, in a blind run by a non-originating tester?
